name: Dare ga Humpty o Koroshita no? ~Lizzie, Futatabi Tantei ni Naru~
original_name: だれがハンプティをころしたの？～リジー、再び探偵になる～
source:
Baron Humpty, the owner of this mansion, was killed by an axe to the head. You (Lizzie) must search for the culprit with your assistant black cat, Dinah.
